# FontanNet

**FontanNet: Growth-Aware, Decision-Focused Active Learning for Robust Pediatric Cardiovascular Conduit Design**

> High school research project (Science and Engineering Fair of Houston / Regeneron ISEF 2027).
> Experimental computational research framework, **not** a clinical tool.

## Overview

FontanNet tests whether a decision-focused active-learning method can identify Fontan
conduit designs that keep indexed power loss low across multiple growth scenarios, while
using fewer CFD simulations than standard optimization methods under an equal budget.

- **CFD:** OpenFOAM (steady, incompressible, laminar) on idealized TCPC geometries
- **Surrogate:** Gaussian process over design x growth scenario, with a reduced-order
  physics model as the prior mean
- **Method:** knowledge-gradient-style decision-focused acquisition
- **Baselines:** random selection, standard Bayesian optimization, implantation-only GP
  optimization, reduced-order model alone
- **Evaluation:** lookup-based benchmark on a precomputed CFD reference grid,
  20+ random seeds, patient-level train/test split
